svg.title: MemOnDemand: bottom-up construction and top-down retrieval
svg.desc: Build an adaptive hierarchy upward from source records. Search distilled memory downward from the highest level, then load selected detailed source evidence.
svg.text: Start at the highest available level
Follow child links; keep details closed
Source details ground answers and citations
Fixed cost + selected detail tokens ≤ B
Cite only loaded sources · Answer input ≤ B
(d) On-demand promotion: maintain active set A
Boost rank; store score + last-use time
Later query: re-score removed nodes; re-promote only if the gate passes
